decision.result: PASS for the exact revised design and closure of the two r1 IRQ blockers; implementation remains unauthorized.

review_method: Read the exact r2 plan/manifest, including all of normative section9, and compare every r1-to-r2 change in sections1..8. Re-check current Arch save/restore/mask and Core terminal-fault contracts, the H743 disable+pending helper and legacy host model behavior, CMSIS direct NVIC disable/enable/pending/active leaves, and local RM EOTIE/TXC/SUSP semantics. No source authoring, tests/builds or new hardware observations were used.

closed_findings.reason: Pure Python/C static assembly and typed lookup perform no MMIO and introduce no runtime construct/reset API. Private hardware initialize and explicit Platform.start/prepare perform actual identity/trim/cache/clock/register/NVIC admission reads before acquisition. Read-only pre-acquisition rejection is distinguished from zero MMIO; partial acquisition failure still has the retained rollback responsibility specified in section3.
closed_findings.future_source_oracle: Separate no-MMIO lookup trace and real initialize/start trace, with identity check preceding V-layout reads. Do not replace either boundary with the other or reconstruct a retained state.

closed_findings.reason: Every SPI IRQ path is forbidden to write IFCR, change CSTART/TSIZE/SPE or reset. Masked EOTIE leaves physical EOT/TXC/SUSP available for task observation. The task alone checks actual CSTART0 with the appropriate SUSP or nonzero-TSIZE finite predicate, then establishes independent quiet. SUSPC precedes SPE0; EOTC follows valid stop/quiet/RX drain/SUSP clear/SPE0. ISR snapshots remain hints, not stop proofs. Stage retention avoids demanding legitimately cleared flags again or replaying the payload.
closed_findings.official_cross_check: RM0433 Rev9 EOTIE enables EOT/SUSP/TXC. For TSIZE nonzero TXC copies EOT including software clearing; SUSP must be cleared before disabling SPI. The revised EOT-before-task and EOT/CSUSP-race oracles directly address the erased-evidence defect.

closed_findings.reason: One owned source mask/ack attempt and readback precede direct disable of only the owned NVIC vector when necessary. ISER0 after barriers proves delivery isolation; ISPR1 and the current handler IABR1 remain legal. The original composite helper is explicitly rejected as the sole sticky-level isolation predicate. Verified isolation permits restoring the incoming mask and returning with Q/loan/owner retained for real task withdrawal. The vector stays disabled through rejected cleanup, and source/flag/pending/active joining is re-proved before any release or re-enable.
closed_findings.terminal_failure_boundary: If neither source isolation nor owned NVIC delivery disable is proved, preserve the first cause and all references, mark the valid active request Q, retain configurable-exception masking, call the existing bounded Core fault observer once, then do not return. This branch is explicitly system fail-stop, with no normal ISR WCET/progress/electrical-safety claim and no masking claim for NMI/HardFault. It never publishes SETTLED, resets ownership or treats observer return as release permission.

closed_findings.result: CLOSED as a design specification, not as a measured bound
closed_findings.reason: The plan now specifies returning-IRQ16read/8write and service-stage64read/16write planning limits, one stage per service, at most8 stopped FIFO byte reads, single source/NVIC attempts and no time/poll/dynamic-retry loops. Shared leaves carry no request/queue/epoch. A terminal fail-stop path is separately excluded from a return-time bound. Concrete implementation must measure and enforce these limits; no existing compile or runtime result is inherited.

IRQ_and_loan_semantic_review: DMA TC/HT/error handling is generation/active-owner-associated diagnostic work. Software-disabled-stream TC cannot become SUCCESS, and TX TC alone proves neither RX completion nor wire idle.
SPI EOT/TXC/SUSP are notification and physical-observation inputs, not an IRQ-owned final settlement decision. No normal ISR releases references, CS or caller payload.
A source-mask refusal cannot be excused by a momentary clear flag. Either all owned enabled sources are proved masked or owned NVIC delivery is proved disabled before a normal return.

Pending delivery and active exception status are distinct from source deassertion and memory/peripheral withdrawal. Disabling delivery preserves a pending1 sticky source without falsely declaring it cleared.

Normal returning paths restore exactly the incoming mask; terminal fail-stop intentionally retains the configurable-exception mask and abandons normal system progress. Do not present the terminal branch as a normal short metadata critical section or bounded service return.

A disabled vector does not establish DMA completion, SPI idle, cache visibility or lifetime join. Q continues to retain request, endpoint, payload and necessary gates until actual hardware withdrawal and external observer/control responsibilities finish.
Cache/DC-bit repair and software QUIET_DONE/isolated-vector state do not replace compatible cache-owner recovery or a fresh valid quiet proof after a broken clock/time epoch.

Task-only final joining checks all relevant source masks, real DMA/SPI stop, exact flags, owned pending0 and inactive vector while protected from a new local IRQ entry; then clear references and publish SETTLED as final request access.
Out-of-owner/exact-vector calls cannot disable or clear foreign resources. Current exception identity must use the actual Arch exception-number contract, not treat raw IRQn as IPSR.

private_additions_justified: A mode-only isolated-vector responsibility mask for the three fixed exclusively owned vectors is necessary retained hardware cleanup state, not a new owner registry.

Small private CMSIS disable/get-enabled/clear-get-pending leaves are justified because the existing H743 helper couples disable to pending-clear success. They avoid weakening System-wide semantics or exposing a new public framework.

The existing Arch barriers/mask primitives and Core nx_fault_observe contract suffice; no new public fault callback, worker, scheduler, queue, global controller pool or runtime constructor is required.
preserved_scope: Public SPI ABI and ordinary polling state remain unchanged; async service still excludes polling drain/finish_clock/park calls.
Finite byte mode directly owns one request; the common spi_dma_sequence backend remains the sole later segmented owner and is not redundantly selected for one byte request.
W1 remains the four-new-file/six-existing-file window already reviewed. D1/D2 mode-only DMA and exact directional tuple/profile/cache-off gates remain separate slices.
The explicit terminal helper is a private irreversible-failure path, not a second general fault-recovery architecture or permission to release a quarantined borrow.

future_oracle_quality.reason: The revised arbiter is driven by real flag+IE, NVIC enabled/pending/active, priority and incoming local masks, and must demonstrate continuous re-pending before a task is allowed to intervene. It does not grant artificial task scheduling as evidence of recovery.
model_self_checks: Nonzero TSIZE EOTC clears EOT and copied TXC.
Idle CSUSP after EOT does not guarantee SUSP.
ICER isolates delivery without automatically clearing the source or guaranteeing pending0; refused ICER preserves actual ISER1.
future_oracle_quality.fault_subprocess: The planned observer records and returns, leaving the actual provider terminal path alive until the parent bounded timeout kills/reaps it. No exception/longjmp/finally reset may fabricate loan return. Recoverable cases remove only external faults and use real service/stop cleanup.
future_oracle_quality.TDD_truthfulness: Missing-symbol RED remains link-contract evidence only. A first correct implementation that immediately passes must be reported honestly; no deliberately broken production body should be invented to manufacture behavior RED. No RED/GREEN was executed by this review.

carried_forward_execution_gates.fresh_hunk_baseline_required: The eight shared-source stale snapshot differences found in r1 remain a baseline-selection gate. Use Root current RTC+S0 integrated commit and final S0.4 nine-source mapping, not old3e whole-file replacement.
carried_forward_execution_gates.evidence_protection: All old S0 source/ELF/XML/raw/cache/compile-DB/freeze artifacts stay immutable; any later execution uses fresh B1 stage and retained directories. This review made no ELF copy or build output.
carried_forward_execution_gates.resource_gate: R2 does not waive output-filesystem and RAM headroom checks or the separate clean-SDK budget. It makes no claim that roughly732MiB current TMP is sufficient for the suggested1.2GiB SDK closure.
carried_forward_execution_gates.required_scope_evidence: Only future actual whole-program Native/configuration/ARM/SDK runs on exact matching source can establish their own results; no HIL, MCU waveform or complete-platform qualification follows from design approval.
